message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Pan 1 killed friend Huang for robbery of gold necklace, then dismembered body, disposed, sold gold. This is robbery (抢劫) because used violence (killing) to take property. Also homicide: murder (故意杀人). In Chinese criminal law, robbery resulting in homicide may be charged as robbery with homicide, but often separate charges: robbery and homicide (or murder). The prosecution says "抢劫罪". But the facts include murder, dismemberment, concealment. Could also be "故意杀人" (intentional homicide). Also "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得" maybe for selling gold? But primary is robbery and homicide. In examples, they sometimes list multiple crimes: e.g., earlier example with fire and robbery gave "放火;抢劫". So we can list both: 抢劫;故意杀人. Also maybe "非法处置尸体" (毁灭证据) but not typical. The pattern: they list crimes like "抢夺" for robbery without homicide. For homicide they use "故意伤害" for assault, "故意杀人" for murder. So answer: [罪名]抢劫;故意杀人<eoa>
